def is_sorted_rotation_of_sorted(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    if n <= 1:
        return True
    rotated = nums[1:] + nums[:1]
    descents = sum(1 for x, y in zip(nums, rotated) if x > y)
    return descents <= 1

def sort_by_manhattan_distance_from_point(points, target):
    tx, ty = target
    decorated = []
    for p in points:
        x, y = p
        decorated.append((abs(x - tx) + abs(y - ty), x, y, p))
    decorated.sort()
    return [item[3] for item in decorated]
